identity_lock: preserve label placement and visible logo
colors: use only colors observed in the uploaded product image

reference_analysis.lighting_language: soft daylight from camera-left with gentle fill
reference_analysis.camera_language: close product coverage with slow push-in
reference_analysis.pacing: three short shots with smooth cuts

reference_observation.subject_plane: single product centered slightly below frame midpoint
reference_observation.composition: vertical close product shot with generous headroom
reference_observation.action: product remains stationary while camera advances
reference_observation.focus_and_dof: product label sharp, background strongly softened

recreation.replace_with_product: replace the reference hero object with the uploaded product while keeping the same screen position and scale
continuity_notes: keep camera-left key light for following shots
recreation.generation_prompt: Use the uploaded product as the exact identity reference. Place it upright on the same style light stone kitchen counter, centered slightly below the vertical frame midpoint, with softly blurred modern cabinetry behind it. Preserve the product's exact silhouette, proportions, materials, visible colors, label layout, and logo placement. Camera at product mid-height, nearly straight-on, close-up framing, normal-to-short-telephoto lens feel, very slow controlled push-in. Large soft daylight from camera-left with neutral white balance, gentle reflections on the product, low-to-medium contrast. Keep the product label critically sharp and the background strongly defocused. Clean neutral commercial grade. No scene redesign.

rendering_notes: photorealistic unless user requests another style

final_master_prompt: Recreate the reference video's visual language shot-by-shot while replacing only the hero object with the uploaded product. Preserve exact product identity and maintain reference location, composition, camera motion, lighting direction, depth of field, pacing, and continuity.
